name: An hour of nothing lets a grumpy mood go
case: A test fails and then the agent's turn fails, so Boop turns grumpy. Then nothing at all happens for over an hour. By then Boop has let it go: its mood is happy again, with a happy face at most.
why: plan/steering/guide.md: any mood goes back to happy after an hour with nothing happening; the heartbeat is the event that brings it, and a heartbeat itself is no reason to mumble. plan/steering/mood/: a failed turn makes Boop grumpy
